query FlxDonateDashboard($range: FlxDonationRange, $from: String, $to: String) {
  flxDonationDashboard(range: $range, from: $from, to: $to) {
    from
    to
    fromLabel
    toLabel
    currency
    symbol
    hasAny
    allDonors
    now {
      total
      gifts
      donors
      newDonors
      average
    }
    prev {
      total
      gifts
      donors
      newDonors
      average
    }
    mrr
    activeSubscriptions
    pastDueSubscriptions
    series {
      day
      label
      oneTime
      recurring
      gifts
    }
    oneTime {
      amount
      gifts
    }
    recurring {
      amount
      gifts
    }
    byType {
      id
      label
      amount
      gifts
    }
    byForm {
      id
      label
      amount
      gifts
    }
    topDonors {
      id
      name
      contact
      amount
      gifts
      url
    }
    canList
    csvUrl
    listUrl
    donorsUrl
    importUrl
    ownOnly
  }
}
